headline: The active path now fails closed on origins, payloads, hidden persistence, and rights leakage.
copy: These controls reduce prototype risk, but they are not a substitute for production identity, secrets, monitoring, abuse prevention, or incident response.

postures.title: Origin policy
postures.copy: Only approved local and GitHub Pages origins receive browser access.

postures.title: Null origin
postures.copy: File-origin browser calls no longer receive local API access.

postures.title: Security headers
postures.copy: No-store, nosniff, frame, referrer, permission, and CSP headers are present.

postures.title: User content storage
postures.copy: Ask, observations, and intake do not persist user-entered content.

postures.title: Translation leakage
postures.copy: The registry and intake contract contain no translation_text field.

flow.title: Minimize
flow.copy: Collect only the question or explicit reviewer draft needed for the task.

flow.title: Validate
flow.copy: Reject unsafe origins, oversized bodies, malformed JSON, and empty questions.

flow.title: Contain
flow.copy: Return source metadata and short summaries with no-store headers.

flow.title: Review
flow.copy: Keep public launch closed until production security operations exist.

decisions.label: Prototype risk
decisions.reason: The most likely local-demo failures now have verified controls.

decisions.label: Production security
decisions.reason: Authentication, authorization, secrets, monitoring, rate limits, and incident response are absent.

decisions.label: Sensitive data
decisions.reason: The active flow should not collect medical, financial, or identifying information.

decisions.label: Public launch
decisions.reason: Security review authorizes the next prototype decision only.

locks.title: Live AI lock
locks.copy: No model call or generated scripture is enabled.

locks.title: Storage lock
locks.copy: No durable learner, reviewer, observation, or telemetry storage is created.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: No translation text is published without recorded rights evidence.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: The product remains study and reflection support, not a guru, clinician, or ritual authority.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Private-demo evidence does not authorize a public service.

Residual: production identity, secrets, rate limiting, monitoring, retention, support, and incident response.
